title: Answer: classical space-time, locality, entropy and the conscious mode emerge

statements.text: Micro-causality and locality emerge on unentangled qubits from a non-local proto-space-time, a classical universe of low entropy emerges when the register decoheres at the end of inflation, and the conscious classical mode of thought emerges from decoherence of the quantum mode.

sources.quote: Micro-causality and locality can be restored in the subset U of Q whose elements are unentangled qubits which we interpret as the states of quantum spacetime
